Method of Attack: PowerShell backdoors and scripts executing arbitrary commands, stealing data, exfiltrating information, and maintaining persistence. PowerExchange uses Microsoft Exchange to receive base64-encoded commands in emails and hides traces by moving emails to 'Deleted Items'. Other tools execute PowerShell commands, enumerate files, steal clipboard data, capture keystrokes, and dump credentials.
Impacted Systems: Government organization systems in the United Arab Emirates
At least 12 computers on victim's network
Dozens more systems with backdoors and keyloggers
Attack Vector: Compromise via PowerShell scripts and commands
Use of Microsoft Exchange for command and control
Use of masqueraded Plink for RDP and SSH tunnels
Deployment of credential dumping and data stealing malware
